verses.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
verses.sm: A UA manao le tupu o Solomona i fafine ese e toatele, e faaopoopo i le afafine o Farao, o fafine o sa Moapi, ma sa Amoni, ma sa Etomā, ma sa Saitonū, ma sa Heti;

verses.en: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.sm: o nuu na fetalai mai ai Ieova i le fanauga a Isaraelu, Aua tou te o atu ia te i latou, aua foi ne‘i latou o mai ia te outou; auā e moni, latou te faaliliuina o outou loto e mulimuli i o latou atua. Ua matuā manao Solomona ia te i latou.

verses.en: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.sm: Sa ia te ia ana avā o alo o alii e toafitu galau, ma ana palake e tolu galau; na faaliliueseina lava lona loto e ana avā.

verses.en: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verses.sm: Auā ua toeaina Solomona ona faaliliueseina lea o lona loto e ana avā e mulimuli i atua ese; na le sao lona loto ia ieova lona Atua, e faapei o le loto o lona tamā o Tavita.

verses.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.sm: Auā na mulimuli atu Solomona ia Asaira le atua fafine o sa Saitonū, na mulimuli foi ia Melekoma le mea leaga a sa Amoni.

verses.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.
verses.sm: Ua amio leaga Solomona i luma o Ieova, ua le matuā' mulimuli atu o ia ia Ieova, e pei o lona tamā o Tavita.

verses.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.sm: Ona fai ai lea e Solomona o le mea maualuga mo Kimosa le mea leaga a Moapi, i le mauga o loo i luma o lerusalema; mo Moloka foi, o le mea leaga a le fanauga a Amoni.

verses.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.sm: Ua faapea foi ona fai e ia mo ana avā uma o nuu ese, o e na faamuina mea manogi, ma fai taulaga i o latou atua.

verses.en: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
verses.sm: Ona toasa lea o ieova ia Solomona, auā ua liliueseina lona loto ia Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu, o le na faaali mai faalua ia te ia,

verses.en: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
verses.sm: ma poloai mai ia te ia i lena lava mea, aua neā mulimuli atu o ia i atua ese; a e lei tausia e ia le mea na poloai mai ai Ieova.

verses.en: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o ieova ia Solomona, Ua ia te oe lenei mea, ua e le tausia foi la‘u feagaiga ma a‘u tulafono na ou poloai atu ai ia te oe, o le mea lea ou te matuā saeeseina ai le malo ia te oe, ma ou foaiina atu i lau auauna.

verses.en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
verses.sm: A ou te le faia lenei mea i lou olaga ona o lou tamā o Tavita; a e ou te saeeseina ai i le lima o lou atalii.

verses.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
verses.sm: A e peitai ou te le saeeseina le malo uma; a ou te foaiina atu le itu aiga e tasi i lou atalii, ona o la‘u auauna o Tavita, ona o Ierusalema foi ua ou filifilia.

verses.en: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.
verses.sm: Ona faatuina mai lea e ieova se tasi e tetee ia Solomona, o Atata o lo sa Etomā, o so le fanau a le tupu sa i Etoma.

verses.en: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.sm: Aua sa i Etoma Tavita, na alu ae foi Ioapo o le pule i ‘au e tatanu i e na fasiotia, ina ua uma ona fasiotia o tane uma i Etoma;

verses.en: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.sm: auā sa nonofo ai loapo ma Isaraelu uma i masina e ono, seia faaumatia tane uma i Etoma;

verses.en: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
verses.sm: ona sosola lea o Atata, o ia ma tagata Etoma, o auauna a iona tamā faatasi ma ia, e o atu i Aikupito, sa tama itiiti foi o Atata.

verses.en: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.sm: Na tulai i latou nai Mitiana, ma latou o atu i Parana; na latou faaopoopo mai ia te i latou tagata o Parana, ma o atu i Aikupito ia Farao le tupu o Aikupito; sa na foai mai ia te ia se fale, ma fai ata e avane mea e ‘ai ia te ia, ua na foai mai foi ia te ia se fanua.

verses.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.sm: Na matuā alofagia Atata e Farao, na ia avatu foi ia te ia o le uso o lona faletua e fai ma ana avā, o le uso lea o le masiofo o Tapenesa.

verses.en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e le uso o Tapenesa ia te ia lona I atalii o Kenupata; na faateaeseina o ia ma le susu e Tapenesa i le fale o Farao; sa i le aiga o Farao o Kenupata faatasi ma atalii o Farao.

verses.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Atata i Aikupito ua taoto Tavita faatasi ma ona tamā, ua oti foi Ioapo le pule i ‘au, ona fai atu lea o Atata ia Farao, Tuu mai ia te au ia ou alu i lo‘u nuu.

verses.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Farao ia te ia, Se a se mea ua e le maua ia te au, ina ua e fia alu lava i lou nuu ? Ona fai atu lea o ia, E leai lava, a ia e matuā tuuina mai ia te au e alu.

verses.en: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.sm: Ua faatuina mai foi e le Atua se tasi e tetee atu ia te ia, o Kesona le atalii o Eliata, o le na sola nai lona alii o Atatesa le tupu o Sopa.

verses.en: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.sm: Na faapotopotoina mai e ia o tagata ia te ia, na fai ai o ia ma alii e avea le ‘au, ina ua fasiotia e Tavita o tagata o Sopa; na latou o foi i Tamaseko ma latou nonofo ai, na pule i latou i Tamaseko.

verses.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.sm: Na ita foi o ia ia Isaraelu i tausaga uma o Solomona e faaopoopo i le leaga na faia e Atata; ua inosia e ia o Isaraelu, na fai foi o ia ma tupu o Suria.

verses.en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.sm: O Ierepoamo foi, o le atalii o Nepata o le sa Efaraimā, mai Seleta, o le auauna ia a Solomona, o Serua foi le igoa o lona tinā, o le fafine ua oti lana tane, na fouvale foi o ia i le tupu.

verses.en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.sm: O le mea foi lenei na fouvale ai o ia i le tupu ; na faia e Solomona o Milo, na ia sosoo i mea na sofaia o le aai a Tavita lona tamā.

verses.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.sm: O lerepoamo foi, o le toa malo i ia; ua iloa e Solomona o le taulealea to‘aga ia, ona ia tofia lea o ia e pule i galuega uma e faia e le aiga o Iosefa.

verses.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
verses.sm: O ona po ia na alu atu ai Ierepoamo nai lerusalema, na iloa o ia i le ala e le perofeta o Akia o le Sailo; na ofu foi o ia i le ofu fou, ua na o i laua i le vao.

verses.en: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
verses.sm: Ona tago lea o Akia i le ofu fou sa ofu ai o ia, ma saei ai i saegāofu e sefulu ma le lua.

verses.en: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
verses.sm: Ona fai atu 'ai lea o ia ia lerepoamo, Ina ave ia mo oe saega e sefulu, auā o loo faapea mai Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu, Faauta, ou te saeia le malo ai le pule a Solomona, ma ou foai atu ia te oe itu aiga e sefulu;

verses.en: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
verses.sm: a e peitai e i ai ia te ia le itu aiga e tasi ona o la‘u auauna o Tavita, ona o Ierusalema foi o le aai na ou filifilia i itu aiga uma o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
verses.sm: Auā ua latou lafoai ia te au, ma ua latou ifo ia Asaira le atua fafine o sa Saitonū, ma Kimosa le atua o Moapi, ma Melekoma le atua o le fanauga a Amoni; e lei savavali foi i latou i o‘u ala e fai ai mea tonu i o‘u luma, ma anaana i a‘u tulafono ma a‘u faamasinoga, e pei o lona tamā o Tavita.

verses.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.sm: A e ou te le ave ese le malo uma ia te ia; auā ou te faia o ia ma alii i aso uma o lona ola, ona o la‘u auauna o Tavita na ou filifilia; auā na ia tausi i a‘u poloaiga ma a‘u tulafono.

verses.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
verses.sm: A e ou te ave ese le malo i lona atalii, ma ou foaiina atu ia te oe o itu aiga e sefulu.

verses.en: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.sm: Ou te foaiina atu foi i lona atalii le itu aiga e tasi ina ia i ai i la‘u auauna o Tavita le lamepa e le aunoa i o‘u luma i Ierusalema le aai na ou filifilia mo a‘u e tuu ai lo‘u igoa.

verses.en: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
verses.sm: Ou te ave foi oe, e te pule i mea uma e manao i ai lou loto, e fai foi oe ma tupu ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
verses.sm: Afai foi e te faalogo i mea uma ou te fai atu ai ia te oe, ma e savali i o‘u ala, ma e faia mea tonu i o‘u luma, ina ia e tausi i a‘u tulafono ma a‘u poloaiga, e pei ona faia e la‘u auauna o Tavita; ona ou i ai lea ia te oe, ma ou fai foi mo oe le aiga tumau, e faapei ona ou faia mo Tavita, ou te foaiina foi o Isaraelu ia te oe.

verses.en: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.sm: Ou te faatigaina foi le fanau a Tavita ona o lenei mea, a e le oo i le faavavau.

verses.en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.sm: Ona lamalama ai lea e Solomona ia fasioti ia Ierepoamo. Ona tulai ai lea o Ierepoamo, ma sola atu i Aikupito ia Seseka le tupu o Aikupito; sa i Aikupito foi o ia ua oo i le oti o Solomona.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e Solomona, ma mea uma na ia saunia, ma lona poto, ua le tusia ea ia i le tusi i rnea na faia e Solomona?

verses.en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.sm: O tausaga na fai ai Solomona ma tupu ia Isaraelu uma lava i lerusalema e fagafulu o tausaga ia.

verses.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ona taoto ai lea o Solomona faatasi ma ona tamā, ua tanumia foi o ia i le aai a Tavita lona tamā; ona soloai ane lea o Reopoamo lona atalii e fai ma tupu. Ua teta ma Reopoamo o itu aiga e
